answer: Farming becomes a thread bet on surviving 97 epochs of grading, and every falcon settlement recomputes the vine schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 97 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 12 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
